query:
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN phone IS NULL OR phone = '' THEN 'no_phone'
    WHEN dndSms IS NOT NULL AND dndSms != '' AND dndSms != '0' THEN 'dnd_sms'
    ELSE 'has_phone_no_dnd'
  END AS reason,
  COUNT(*) AS total
FROM leads 
WHERE DATEDIFF(NOW(), createdAt) >= 365
  AND preferredChannel = 'Email'
  AND (opportunityStatus IS NULL OR opportunityStatus NOT IN ('won', 'lost', 'abandoned'))
  AND humanTakeover = 0
GROUP BY CASE 
    WHEN phone IS NULL OR phone = '' THEN 'no_phone'
    WHEN dndSms IS NOT NULL AND dndSms != '' AND dndSms != '0' THEN 'dnd_sms'
    ELSE 'has_phone_no_dnd'
  END;
